name: ClashDoctor live Qloo probe v2 — 30 established artists
purpose: Measure what real Qloo data supports for a fixed, diverse set of 30 established artists before changing any scoring logic. This file is human-authored input, not Qloo output.

notes.fixed_list: The supplied list contained Radiohead twice. The duplicate was replaced with Fela Kuti as instructed; all other names are the supplied ones.
notes.labels: All 30 artists are established, internationally documented acts. This probe makes no established-versus-emerging comparison.
notes.take_depth: The documented /v2/insights endpoint accepted take=30 and take=50 on 2026-10-23 and rejected take=100 with HTTP 400. No pagination parameter is documented or implemented in app.qloo.QlooClient. This probe therefore uses take=50 as the largest documented-accepted depth and does not invent pagination.
notes.human_judgment: Scenes and sanity checks are editorial descriptions from public genre information. They are hypotheses for inspection, not ground truth and not evidence of shared audience.

sanity_checks.hypothesis: If the profiles carry the expected vocabulary, these acts should show a plausible electronic/experimental affinity.
This cross-scene pair may score lower than the similar checks; the evidence should be inspected rather than assumed.
Both are electronic duos; a shared electronic/dance vocabulary is plausible if Qloo returns it.
Both are contemporary hip-hop stars; overlapping hip-hop vocabulary is plausible, but this is not a claim of audience overlap.
Both carry rock and metal lineage; shared rock vocabulary would be interpretable evidence, not proof of fan overlap.
